title: SCIM: project the enterprise `manager` attribute into sys_user.manager_id, so SCIM-held users' managers can change at all
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Follow-up named by the #33200 ruling (comment 6895645364, maintainer option A).

## Gap

After #33200, `admin-set-user-manager` refuses only users a SCIM directory holds (a `sys_scim_subject` row), telling the admin to change the manager in the directory. But no code projects the SCIM enterprise `manager` attribute into `sys_user.manager_id`: `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts:155-159` records the attribute as declared with zero non-test projection sites, and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim*` has none either. So for a SCIM-held user, the directory cannot set the manager and the admin is refused: no path changes it.

## Done when

1. A SCIM create/replace/patch carrying `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:manager.value` sets `manager_id` to the matching user in the same org, subject to the same four refusals as the admin endpoint (self, cycle, depth, cross-org), answered as SCIM errors.
2. A manager value naming no known user is refused loudly, not dropped.
3. Clearing the attribute clears `manager_id`.
4. The lint note at `validate-approval-approvers.ts:155-159` and its rule explanation are updated to match.

## Notes

- Clause-②: yes (widening): a SCIM request that today ignores `manager` will start writing it.
- Order: after the #33200 build (same refusal helpers; reuse them, do not copy).
- Does not touch ADR-0135 D4 stamping.

Pre-claim lane: domain:server, auth area (plugin-auth SCIM).
